reason: A hot-pluggable UI theme plugin that adds eight built-in palettes and supports importing, applying, persisting, and deleting custom color palettes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供八种内置配色，并支持导入、应用、保存和删除自定义配色主题。
summaries.en: Provides eight built-in color palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web interface and supports importing, applying, saving, and deleting custom themes.

capabilities: Adds selectable built-in color palettes to the web interface
Imports and derives custom color palettes from user-provided colors and token overrides
Persists palette selections and imported palettes in plugin settings
Applies palette changes across interface surfaces including backgrounds, text, buttons, code areas, sidebar, and scrollbars
